pageCache.pageTitle: South Stoke Primary School - Head's welcome
pageCache.text:
Welcome to South Stoke Primary School
It is a privilege to be the Executive Headteacher of South Stoke Primary School, and I am delighted to lead the school as part of our growing collaboration with the Federation of Goring and Stoke Row Church of England Primary Schools. Working collaboratively across all three schools provides exciting opportunities to share expertise, ideas and resources, while ensuring that each school retains its own distinctive identity, character and strong sense of community.
South Stoke is a very special village school. Its small size creates a warm, welcoming and nurturing environment where children are known as individuals and where strong relationships between children, staff and families are at the heart of school life.
Our three school values, Confidence, Compassion and Curiosity, are at the heart of everything we do. We encourage children to have the confidence to try new things, make mistakes and believe in themselves; the compassion to care for others, show kindness and understand different perspectives; and the curiosity to ask questions, explore ideas and develop a lifelong love of learning.
We are ambitious for our children and are continually developing an exciting and engaging curriculum that provides rich opportunities for learning both inside and outside the classroom. We want children to develop strong foundations in reading, writing and mathematics while also having opportunities to explore science, the arts, sport, history, geography and the wider world. Our aim is to create memorable learning experiences that children will carry with them throughout their education and an understanding of their place within their community and the wider world.
We would be delighted to welcome prospective families to visit South Stoke Primary School. There is no better way to discover what makes our school special than to come and see it for yourself, meet our children and staff, and experience our warm and welcoming community.
We look forward to welcoming you.
Angela Wheatcroft Executive Headteacher South Stoke Primary School

The school uses Twinkl as our phonics scheme and our reading books support the teaching of phonics.
We do not rigidly keep to a scheme as we believe the children should have a wide breadth of books to choose from and which support the teaching of phonics, including Twinkl-published books.

SEND
At South Stoke Primary we are committed to helping every child succeed and achieve their full potential. We recognise that every single child is different, with their own unique talents, but every child is equally precious.
We know that children come to school with different strengths and experiences and at some point, many children may find some aspects of school challenging. These may be academic, social, behavioural or emotional challenges.
At our school, we share an inclusive ethos and a commitment to supporting all children.
Our SENDCO is Miss Wadsworth.
Identification, assessment and provision
The school will follow the guidance contained within the Oxfordshire County Council document Identifying and Supporting Special Educational Needs (OCC 2014).
Where learners are not making expected progress and are significantly behind their peers, evidence is gathered from school, home and the learner themself to make a detailed assessment of need and put in place appropriate support. For those with the most complex needs, an Education Health and Care (EHC) plan will be agreed.
Admission of pupils with SEND
In accordance with legal requirements, children who have an Educational, Health and Care Plan naming the school in that plan will always be admitted. Children with disabilities who need to be admitted to a school on the grounds of physical accessibility have a priority in the school’s Admission Policy.

pageCache.pageTitle: South Stoke Primary School - South Stoke Parents Association
pageCache.text:
South Stoke School Parents Association
South Stoke Parents Association is a registered charity and is dedicated to supporting the wonderful primary school and enhancing the educational experience for all the lovely pupils who attend the school.
All parents are automatic members of the Parents Association and all are welcome. It is run by parent volunteers and the association organises fundraising events, social activities for the children, and provides valuable assistance to school initiatives. Funds raised typically go towards resources, extracurricular activities and subsidising school trips to enable inclusivity so all children can take part.
Regular meetings are held and there is an active WhatsApp group offering parents an opportunity to contribute ideas and get involved in various projects. The association welcomes new members and encourages active participation to foster a strong partnership between families and the school.
The activities the PA support include the school trip to Windsor Castle and the Oxford Story Museum which the children loved. We have also organised the school Christmas party and donated Christmas gifts to the children.
For more details about upcoming events or how to join, you can visit the school's official website or contact the association directly via southstokeschoolpa@gmail.com. We value feedback from the Local South Stoke community so please feel free to get in touch.
Please see our Facebook page for more information

pageCache.pageTitle: South Stoke Primary School - After-school clubs
pageCache.text:
After-school clubs
Despite being a small school, we still manage to run after school clubs. We believe that the National Curriculum only goes so far in educating our children and they all have an opportunity to expand their extra curriculum experiences after each school day.
Whilst many parents are able to collect their children at 3.15pm, having the school clubs in place means that working parents are given breathing space when it comes to leaving work to collect their child. We are strong believers in the important role that our clubs can play in the development of our pupils.

pageCache.pageTitle: South Stoke Primary School - Curriculum overview
pageCache.text:
Curriculum overview
At South Stoke Primary we provide a caring, consistent and stimulating learning environment which encourages pupils to grow and develop in an atmosphere of mutual respect and which embraces not only the home-school partnership but which seeks also to make maximum use of the educational opportunities offered by the local business and professional community.
We encourage pupils to take active responsibility for their own learning, to aim high and to take pride in their own achievements. Every child matters at South Stoke and every decision we take is based on what is in the best interests of the children.
It is important to us that the children at South Stoke feel happy and secure, that they respect each other and that they have the self confidence to be the best they can be in a wide range of areas.
At South Stoke Primary School, we have high expectations of all pupils and we adapt our curriculum and provision to allow all to join in. Our accessibility plan states how we accomplish this in school.
For more information on the school's curriculum please email office.2507@south-stoke.oxon.sch.uk
